capacity_metric_note: Q_sim integrates the experimentally measured current over the experimental time window, so Q_sim ~= Q_exp by construction.  Do NOT read baseline Q_sim-Q_exp as a capacity prediction; predictive capacity requires a constant-current run where the model itself reaches the cutoff.

parameter_match.experimental_cell: Graphite || Li metal, R2032 coin cell, 14 mm disc, 64 um, 1.40 mAh/cm2 (catalog id 4ccc47, label Gr-AQ-1)
parameter_match.notes: PyBaMM BUILT-IN reference set (not fitted to this dataset). Same chemistry class (graphite || Li metal) but a different cell: the set describes an 85.85 cm2 electrode with a per-area capacity of ~2.36 mAh/cm2 (declared nominal 156.25 mAh) against 1.54 cm2 / ~1.40 mAh/cm2 here.  Consequences, recorded rather than hidden: (a) at the same absolute current the model sees ~56x lower current density, (b) the model stores ~1.9x more Li per cm2, so the replayed branch covers only ~1 % of the model capacity.  The Phase A zero-fit RMSE is therefore a SCALE ARTEFACT, reported for chain validation only - never as model error, never as validation.  Geometry-matched parameters are Phase C work.
